Database.doc: Storage facade handle. Opens cursors, manages transactions, exposes schema introspection. Internals are owned by this part.

CursorHandle.doc: Opaque cursor handle. The VDBE holds these by value in its cursor slots; it never introspects them. Positional operations (seek, next, column) are routed via free functions declared here.

open_read_cursor.doc: Open a read-only cursor on the named table. Err(TableNotFound) if the table doesn't exist.

open_write_cursor.doc: Open a writable cursor on the named table. Err(TableNotFound) if the table doesn't exist.

close_cursor.doc: Consume a cursor handle and release its backing resources (page pins, index state, writable-lock, etc.). Never fails — closing an already-consumed handle is unreachable because the function takes the handle by ownership. Targets with implicit destructor semantics (Rust Drop, Go GC, Python __del__) may implement this as a no-op body; targets with manual resource management (C, Zig deinit) must release here.

open_index_cursor.doc: Open a read-only cursor on the named index. Err(TableNotFound) if the index doesn't exist (spec conflates missing table and missing index under TableNotFound — the compiler guarantees the name refers to an index before emitting this opcode).

cursor_seek_ge.doc: Position cursor at smallest index key >= the supplied key. Ok(true) if such an entry exists; Ok(false) if all entries are strictly less than the key (past-end).

cursor_seek_gt.doc: Position cursor at smallest index key > the supplied key. Ok(true) if such an entry exists; Ok(false) past-end.

cursor_seek_le.doc: Position cursor at largest index key <= the supplied key. Ok(true) if such an entry exists; Ok(false) if all entries are strictly greater (before-start).

cursor_seek_lt.doc: Position cursor at largest index key < the supplied key. Ok(true) if such an entry exists; Ok(false) before-start.

cursor_idx_next.doc: Advance the index cursor to the next entry. Ok(true) if another entry exists (cursor moved); Ok(false) if past-end (cursor stays at EOF position).

cursor_idx_rowid.doc: Read the rowid of the row the index cursor currently points at. Err(CursorClosed) if the cursor is at EOF/BOF or has been closed.
